handoff.observation_window: 2026-10-21/22 UTC; historical inventory, not current clearance

fw-l2.filter: tcp and (port 502 or port 4840 or port 8000)
fw-l2.coverage: routed traffic involving L2; use this side only for counts
fw-l2.prerequisite: reconfirm tap/MAC attachment; capture-open privilege unverified

plc-l1.coverage: PLC-VFD, PLC-scanner, plant-PLC and routed PLC traffic
plc-l1.prerequisite: reconfirm tap/MAC attachment; never sum routed PLC traffic with fw-l2

xle-local.attachment: guest route to 127.0.0.1 is local dev lo
xle-local.coverage: XLe-ASX HTTP; invisible from host taps
xle-local.prerequisite: separate guest write/privilege approval; verify timeout/prlimit, clock bounds and capture-open rights

scada-local.attachment: guest route to 10.10.2.10 is local dev lo
scada-local.coverage: HMI-OPC UA subscription/commands; connectedness does not prove fresh PLC data
scada-local.prerequisite: separate guest write/privilege approval; verify timeout/prlimit, clock bounds and capture-open rights

drives-local.attachment: PROPOSED ONLY: drives routes, aliases and local path unread
drives-local.coverage: plant-VFD local RPM polling if routing confirms local delivery
drives-local.prerequisite: BLOCKED: authenticate separately, read routes/tools, resolve scanner address discrepancy; update reviewed config only after observation
